column1: # [acct2-decomp] The censored campaign (c3w/censored.py): the insignia textures inside the campaign's
# level archives (sp/<level>/<level>.cod), which can't be swapped whole because they also carry the
# language. For each: the level archive, the texture's name in the USA/Europe disc's directory, its
# name in the German disc's. The German release has other pixels at the same item, the same size and
# format; a copy of the game's own level archive gets the other release's pixels there.
# Names only (from the discs' directories, acct2-decomp 2026-11-05); no game data.
